comment: Query spec for the search smoke test. Relevant queries must surface their expected function within top-3 at the default search threshold; noise queries must return no results at all.

relevant.query: parse rows from a csv file
retry a failing call with exponential backoff
evict the least recently used cache entry
binary search for the insertion point in a sorted list
rate limit requests using a token bucket

noise: water the tomato plants in the garden
